facts.name: English Lavender
facts.notes: Fragrant silver-gray mounds with purple spikes in summer. Needs sharp drainage; wet winter soil kills it.

sources.title: Bordine's (Michigan garden center): perennials by bloom time, 2026
sources.note: Current perennial list from a Michigan garden center.

sources.title: Purdue Extension: Prune Lavender at the Right Time
sources.note: Lavender is marginally hardy in the Midwest; wait to prune until new growth is under way in spring.

companions.why: Walters Gardens (Zeeland, Michigan) lists varieties of these as companions: yarrow, Shasta daisy, catmint 'Walker's Low' and Salvia nemorosa.
